items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: I was talking to John and John was telling me, he said, you willing to play for them, he says, how many hours? I said, I can't make eight hours.

ctx.x: I notice most of the old ones take pretty good care of themselves now.

I'm glad they do. I was talking to him. He's in the record band and he told me. He said, I got enough of it already. I got enough of it already. He said, I can't think too much of it. He said, I can't think too much of it. He said, I tell them that too. See, I got them for five or six hours. After that I didn't want no more of it. Well I'll tell you, I was talking to John and John was telling me, he said, you willing to play for them, he says, how many hours? I said, I can't make eight hours. He said, I'll play…
Who can be a member of your club, by the way? Who can join your club?
